title: Every cron route authenticates with hasSchedulerSecret and fails closed

requirements.expectation: cashout/verify, payout-retry, egress-ip, notification-retry, analytics-rollup and purge-accounts authenticate schedulers only through hasSchedulerSecret(); no local cronAuthorized/authorized copy remains.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; grep for cronAuthorized and searchParams.get("secret") under src/app/api returns nothing.
evidence: Source, 2026-11-21: all six routes call hasSchedulerSecret(req); grep for cronAuthorized, searchParams.get("secret") and ALLOW_OPEN_PAYOUT_CRON under src (outside tests) returns nothing.

Old-code note: purge-accounts read CRON_SECRET once at module load, so in tests the old route was open as if no secret were set; on a host where the secret is present at load it already refused. The new code reads the secret per request.

requirements.expectation: With no secret configured, every one of the six routes returns 401 to a scheduler-style request in any NODE_ENV, and runs no work.
requirements.verification: Route tests per route with CRON_SECRET, ONA_CRON_SECRET and JOB_EXPIRE_SECRET blank under NODE_ENV=development.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21: each route's test sets all three secrets blank under NODE_ENV=development (with VERCEL=1, ALLOW_OPEN_PAYOUT_CRON=true and a vercel-cron UA) and gets 401 with no work, for every method. Against the old route code this case fails on all six routes (11 method cases).

requirements.expectation: ?secret=<valid secret> and a 'vercel-cron' User-Agent are refused (401, no work) on every route; ALLOW_OPEN_PAYOUT_CRON no longer opens payout-retry.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21: ?secret=<valid> and a vercel-cron User-Agent return 401 with no work on every route and method. Against the old code ?secret= fails on all six routes (11 method cases).

requirements.expectation: Authorization: Bearer <secret> and x-cron-secret: <secret> run the route's work and return its existing success body.
requirements.verification: Route tests per route with the work function mocked.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21: Authorization: Bearer and x-cron-secret get past auth on every route and method; after-auth tests check each route's existing success body (and analytics-rollup's existing 500 without Supabase, purge-accounts' 503 no_db).

requirements.expectation: payout-retry without a scheduler secret still runs for an admin with escrow_release (source: admin) and returns the admin auth error otherwise.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21: payout-retry without a secret runs for an admin with escrow_release (source: admin), returns the AdminAuthError status/code otherwise (403 forbidden), and a scheduler run reports source: cron without calling requirePermission.

requirements.expectation: Status codes and response bodies after auth are unchanged on every route.
requirements.verification: Diff inspection: only the auth gate changes in each route.
evidence: Diff, 2026-11-21: each route only swaps its gate call and drops the local function (6 files, 22 insertions, 133 deletions); purge-accounts keeps no_db before auth as before.

requirements.expectation: MUTATION_INVENTORY.md rows for these routes, VERCEL_DEPLOY.md cron notes and BACKEND_FIXES_STATUS.md reflect header-only, fail-closed auth.
evidence: Source, 2026-11-21: MUTATION_INVENTORY.md rows for the six routes, VERCEL_DEPLOY.md cron auth paragraph, BACKEND_FIXES_STATUS.md section.

requirements.expectation: Full test suite, typecheck and lint pass.
requirements.verification: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21 on uncommitted fix/cron-auth-fail-closed (from dev 0f3a2ed): vitest 283 files / 2,805 tests pass; tsc --noEmit passes; eslint 0 errors, 142 warnings, none in changed files.

requirements.expectation: After deploy, every Vercel cron and the pg_cron payout-retry job still return 200; an unauthenticated request to each route returns 401.
requirements.verification: Vercel cron logs, cron.job_run_details for ona-payout-retry, and a curl without a secret against each route on the host.

code: Independent review against the implementation commit.
external: Confirm CRON_SECRET is set on every Vercel deployment that runs crons (Vercel sends it as the Bearer token); without it every cron route now returns 401.
Confirm the pg_cron payout_retry_secret (ona_cron_config) equals a host cron secret, then check cron.job_run_details for ona-payout-retry returning 200.
Any external scheduler (cron-job.org) must send Authorization: Bearer <secret> or x-cron-secret, never ?secret=.
After deploy, curl each of the six routes without a secret and confirm 401.
